item.title: [英语] Introduction to Computer Science Ch1 Problem Set A - 2026-07-13 05:44
item.description:
⏱ 预计阅读时间：4 分钟 (200 字符)

原文 阅读解析 翻译参考 词汇 表达讲解
Research examples of how modeling and simulations have led to new inventions and discoveries. Research / examples of / how modeling and simulations / have led to / new inventions and discoveries. 研究关于建模和模拟如何导致新发明和发现的例子。 modeling: 建模
simulations: 模拟
led to: 导致
inventions: 发明
discoveries: 发现		 “have led to” 为现在完成时，表示“已经导致”；“how…led to…” 是宾语从句；“examples of…” 表示“……的例子”。
Research and provide a summary of the difference between artificial intelligence and machine learning. Research / and provide / a summary of / the difference between / artificial intelligence / and / machine learning. 研究并提供人工智能和机器学习之间差异的总结。 artificial intelligence: 人工智能
machine learning: 机器学习
summary: 总结
difference: 差异		 “provide a summary of…” 意为“提供……的总结”；“the difference between A and B” 是固定结构，表示“A 与 B 的区别”。
